title: GOV-0039: shadow-evaluate the completed badf-research P0 family on real historical BADF cases (SHADOWED admission evidence)
problem:
## Observed
`badf-research` is a complete P0 family (9 of 9 subskills, 26 of 26 controls) but sits at `DESIGNED`, validated only against synthetic examples. The admission ladder requires a `SHADOWED` step before `APPROVED`/`ACTIVE`: run the contract retrospectively on real historical BADF cases and ask whether it would have surfaced the correct uncertainty, evidence, contradiction and decision boundary without knowing the answer.

## Expected
Produce the shadow evidence: author **three digest-bound, gate-valid research records** over distinct real historical BADF cases, each exercising a different part of the contract, plus a short admission-evidence note measuring whether the contract represented the real case faithfully:
- **R02 repository-investigation** — was control 15 (only `RESEARCH_SUFFICIENT` → downstream work package) enforced, or only documented? (baseline `bstBizEra/badf@e7ea929`) — the case that surfaced the control-15 mistracking this session.
- **R03 root-cause** — why did WP-0019 turn `main` red at `30186c5` after a green PR? (baseline `bstBizEra/badf@30186c5`) — the composed-tree-red / pre-merge-ledger defect.
- **R10 fact-verification** — does a green local run prove a green CI run? (`FALSIFIED` by the #57 PyYAML runner-parity defect, with the contradiction preserved).

Add them to CI (`research` validation) and write the admission-evidence note. `badf-research` stays `DESIGNED` — the status advance is the operator's admission decision, now backed by shadow data.

## Evidence
- all three baselines resolve (`bstBizEra/badf` registered SELF; `e7ea929`, `30186c5` in history)
- the three synthetic examples pass but do not constitute historical shadow evidence

## Unknowns
Whether the contract can faithfully represent all three cases is the point of the exercise; a gap becomes its own issue rather than a silent pass.

## Proposed work package
`BADF-WP-0055`. Three shadow research records in `examples/` + CI validation; an admission-evidence note; own G07 self-dossier. C2. `badf-research` stays `DESIGNED` (shadow evidence produced; status advance = operator).
